messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Heard you may got some mushrooms...I've been looking for some...

messages.text: Thank ya man, I knew I could trust you! These will come in good use!

messages.zh: 谢了兄弟,我就知道能信你! 这些可派上大用场了!

messages.text: Oh man gee, that's awful man, call me when you got 'em alright?
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 哦天哪,这太糟了兄弟,等你有了再叫我,好吗?
